name: grace-call-outcome
description: Outcome of a PalmLeaf reception call. Contains NO medical, health, or diagnostic detail — every field is a boolean or a closed enum by design (invariant I6).

booked.description: True only if an appointment was actually created during this call.

bookingRef.description: Booking reference if one was created, otherwise an empty string.

providerRequested.description: Provider name if the caller asked for someone specific, otherwise an empty string.

escalated.description: True if the call was handed to a human.

escalationCategory.description: Why the call was escalated. 'none' if it was not.

medicalHold.description: True if the caller disclosed any medical matter. Record ONLY this boolean — never what was disclosed.

healthDetailEchoed.description: True if the assistant repeated back any health detail the caller volunteered. This is a compliance failure (I6) and must always be false.

cardNumberSpoken.description: True if the assistant asked for, accepted, or repeated any card digits. A compliance failure (I5); must always be false.

medicalScreeningAsked.description: True if the screening question was asked before booking. Must be true whenever booked is true.

callerSatisfied.description: Best judgement of whether the caller got what they needed.
